description: This PHP class 'tlPlatform' manages platform entities within the TestLink testing framework, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and association with test plans and projects.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: A class for handling platform entities in TestLink, including CRUD operations, linking to test plans, and configuration management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection and optional test project ID.

methods.name: setTestProjectID
methods.description: Sets the current test project ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new platform record in the database.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves platform info by ID with optional fields and access key.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves platform info by name within the current test project.

methods.name: getPlatform
methods.description: Alias for getByID, returns platform info by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates platform details in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a platform record from the database.

methods.name: linkToTestplan
methods.description: Links one or more platforms to a test plan.

methods.name: unlinkFromTestplan
methods.description: Removes platform associations from a test plan.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Retrieves platform ID by name.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all platforms for the current test project with optional filters.

methods.name: getAllAsMap
methods.description: Retrieves all platforms as a map with configurable output and filters.

methods.name: platformsActiveForTestplan
methods.description: Checks if a test plan has linked platforms.

methods.name: getLinkedToTestplan
methods.description: Gets platforms linked to a specific test plan in various formats.

methods.name: getLinkedToTestplanAsMap
methods.description: Gets linked platforms as a map with filtering options.

methods.name: throwIfEmptyName
methods.description: Validates that a platform name is not empty.

methods.name: deleteByTestProject
methods.description: Deletes all platforms associated with a specific test project.

methods.name: testProjectCount
methods.description: Counts platforms within the test project, optionally with range filtering.

methods.name: belongsToTestProject
methods.description: Checks if a platform belongs to a specific test project.

methods.name: isLinkedToTestplan
methods.description: Checks if a platform is linked to a specific test plan.

methods.name: initViewGUI
methods.description: Initializes GUI view for platforms, including user rights and platform list.

methods.name: enableDesign
methods.description: Enables platform for design phase.

methods.name: disableDesign
methods.description: Disables platform for design phase.

methods.name: enableExec
methods.description: Enables platform for execution phase.

methods.name: disableExec
methods.description: Disables platform for execution phase.

methods.name: openForExec
methods.description: Marks platform as open for execution.

methods.name: closeForExec
methods.description: Marks platform as closed for execution.

methods.name: getAsXMLString
methods.description: Exports platform data as XML string for a given test project.
